title: Containers
offline: The agent of this server is not connected, so its containers cannot be shown or managed.
noDocker: Docker is not available on this server.
empty: This server has no containers yet.
refreshFailed: The list could not be refreshed: the last data is shown.

confirm.removeBody: The container is deleted. Its volumes are kept.
confirm.stopBody: The container stops; services that depend on it will stop answering. You can start it again.

progress.timeout: The agent did not answer in time.

logs.title: Logs of {{name}}
logs.note: Last 200 lines, each with its time.

stacks.title: Stacks
stacks.intro: Docker Compose projects Talaia keeps on the server and manages for you.
stacks.brokenBody: The files of this project are gone from the server. Stop managing it to clean this entry.
stacks.empty: There are no managed stacks yet. Create the first one with "New stack".

confirm.downBody: Its containers are stopped and removed. Volumes are kept.
confirm.removeBody: Its containers are stopped and its files are deleted from the server. Volumes are kept.
confirm.forgetBody: Talaia forgets this stack. The containers and the files stay as they are.

editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: Lower case letters, digits, dash and underscore.
editor.rootNote: A Compose file is run as root on the server. Anyone who can edit it can control the server.
editor.envHint: Variables for the compose file. It is stored on the server readable by root only.

adopt.title: Running projects
adopt.intro: Compose projects that already run on the server. When you manage them they stay where they are: nothing is copied or restarted.

resources.title: Images, volumes and networks
resources.intro: What Docker keeps on the server. What no container uses can be removed to free space.
resources.empty: There is nothing of this kind.
resources.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Docker refuses by itself what is still in use.
resources.confirmVolumes: Volumes are among them: they may hold data that cannot be recovered.

terminal.title: Terminal of {{name}}
terminal.hostUnavailable: Not available: update the agent or enable it in agent.toml
terminal.hostConfirmBody: This opens a shell as root on {{name}}. It is recorded (what you type is kept when the screen shows it). Anyone with this panel session can do anything on the server.
terminal.confirmBody: You get a shell inside the container, with the permissions of its user. The session is recorded: everything the container prints is kept, including what you type when the screen shows it.
terminal.recordingHint: This session is recorded. Do not type passwords that the screen shows.
terminal.privileged: This container has full access to the server (privileged, host processes or the Docker socket). The terminal is as good as root on the server.
terminal.connectionLost: The connection with the terminal was lost.

ended.max_duration: Closed: a session cannot last more than 4 hours.
ended.agent_offline: The agent of the server disconnected.
ended.agent_busy: The agent could not keep up with the keystrokes.
ended.slow_client: Closed because the browser did not keep up with the output.
ended.ticket_expired: The terminal was not connected in time.
ended.recording_limit: Closed: the recording reached its size limit.
ended.recording_failed: Closed: the recording could not be stored.

agentUpdate.confirmBody: The panel downloads the package from the core, verifies its SHA-256, installs it and restarts the agent. Containers are not touched; the server shows offline for a moment.

errors.agent_offline: The agent of this server is not connected.
errors.no_update: There is no newer agent package.
errors.update_in_progress: An agent update is already in progress.
errors.session_required: The session ended. Sign in again.
errors.generic: The update could not be started.

manualUpdate.explanation: This agent is too old to update itself. Run this command once on the server; later versions update from the panel.
manualUpdate.docs: See the installation guide for the manual steps.

updates.title: Updates
updates.intro: Pending package updates the agent found. Upgrade them without removing any package.
updates.rebootBody: Some updates only take effect after the server restarts.
updates.error: The updates could not be read: {{message}}
updates.invalid: The agent returned an unexpected answer.

upgrade.body: Packages are upgraded without removing any. Local configuration files are kept. Services may restart.
upgrade.dockerWarning: Docker will restart and so will your containers: {{packages}}.
upgrade.heldNote_one: {{count}} held package stays at its current version.
upgrade.heldNote_other: {{count}} held packages stay at their current version.
upgrade.waiting: Waiting for the first log lines…
upgrade.emptyLog: The agent sent no log lines.

reboot.title: Reboot the server?
reboot.body: The server will be unreachable for about a minute while it restarts.
reboot.running: Rebooting… the server will reconnect by itself.

updates.heldHint: Held packages stay at their current version until they are unheld on the server.

services.title: Services
services.invalid: The agent returned an unexpected state.
services.loadError: The services could not be loaded: {{message}}
services.selfManaged: Talaia updates this service with the agent update.
services.accessWarning: You may lose access to this server.

confirm.stopBody: The service stops and the things that depend on it may stop working.
confirm.restartBody: The service stops and starts again; the things that depend on it may be interrupted.
confirm.disableBody: The service will not start automatically after the next boot.

journal.title: Journal
journal.intro: Systemd journal entries from the server. Search the last lines or follow new ones.
journal.unitHint: Choose a reported service or type a unit name.
journal.rangeInvalid: The end of the range must be after its start.
journal.searchPlaceholder: Plain text, not a regular expression
journal.searchHint: The text is matched literally; it is not a regular expression.
journal.error: The journal could not be read: {{message}}
journal.invalid: The agent returned an unexpected answer.
journal.note: The newest entries are at the bottom. Follow asks for new entries every 3 seconds.
journal.followNeedsNoUntil: Follow needs an open-ended range: remove the end time.

containers.empty: This stack has no containers yet.
